principle: The client should never need to ask how much has been spent, what the next step costs, or how much credit is needed.

policy_conflict_requires_founder_decisio.today: Existing firewalls classify provider spend as founder-internal (CLIENT_CONTROL_ROOM_FIREWALL PROVIDER_SPEND; stripInternalFields providerCostCents, margin*). Ground Zero canon lists ACCESS_INTERNAL_COSTS as a client MAY-NOT.
policy_conflict_requires_founder_decisio.proposal: Split costs into CLIENT_VISIBLE_PRODUCTION_EXPENSE (pass-through third-party generation the client funds or is billed for — shown) and INTERNAL_COST (margin, labor cost, SITE 00 model/API spend, retries the founder absorbs — never shown). Visibility of each estimate is founder-approved per family.

cost_center_rule: Not an accounting system; not an invoice dashboard. Legal contracting/invoices are audited separately (site00_invoices is demo-seeded; no payments rails).
ledger_storage: NEW site00_generation_cost_ledger (project_id, family_id, authority/asset id, generation_class, provider, model, settings, estimated/actual credits, credit_price_usd, estimated/actual usd, payer, provider_connection_id, status ESTIMATED|APPROVED|SPENT|FAILED|REFUNDED|UNALLOCATED, idempotency_key). Never stores secrets or raw provider requests.
backfill: JURNL F01/F02 GENERATION_LEDGER rows (incl. UNALLOCATED 155 credits; 2,975-credit gap between ledgers recorded as UNATTRIBUTED, not invented).

estimate_language.confidence: LOW · EXPECTED · HIGH or a range

dual_units: Show dollars first; credits second ("$18–$25 · ABOUT 6,000–8,000 CREDITS"). Never require understanding credits, tokens or model pricing.

forecast_method.learning: Estimates per family = Σ(planned generations by class × unit rate) × observed retry factor from completed families of the SAME project when ≥1 exists (AIO uses AIO data as it accumulates), else cross-project prior (JURNL F01/F02).
forecast_method.example: A family planned like JURNL F02 (≈23 generations + repairs) → EXPECTED ≈ 9,500 credits ≈ $28; range LOW–HIGH ≈ $22–$40 (ESTIMATED).

existing_code_risk: SelfDirectedOpsSignals invents credits (usedCredits = reviewCount*5) — must be removed before this model ships.
